question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "want."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The use of **"want"** in the blank completes the sentence to convey the intended meaning.
 
• In this context, **"want"** is used to express the idea of someone desiring or being willing to undergo a diagnosis for Alzheimer's disease even before they are aware of having the condition. (इस संदर्भ में,** "want"** का उपयोग किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के विचार को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है जो अल्जाइमर रोग की स्थिति के बारे में पता होने से पहले ही इसका निदान कराना चाहता है या कराने को तैयार है।)
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• **Correct paragraph**:

You may wonder if anyone would **want**__ to be diagnosed before they are even aware they have Alzheimer's ______ (2) _______? A recent survey shows that, indeed, they would. ______ (3) ______ three-quarters of the respondents said they would want ______ (4) ______ if they had Alzheimer’s disease, even if they were not yet experiencing ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Got: **to receive, obtain, or buy something. (किसी वस्‍तु को पाना, लेना या ख़रीदना)
 
• **Drop: **to let something fall. (गिराना, गिरने देना)
 
• **Surrender: **to stop fighting and admit that you have lost. (लड़ना बंद कर अपनी हार मान लेना, आत्‍मसमर्पण कर देना)
